description: HaulNavi EU helps road-freight operators estimate trip costs and margins, compare route-cost scenarios, quantify waiting and empty-kilometre costs, plan against already-confirmed available driving time, and check operational readiness. Calculations use figures supplied by the user. Results are operational estimates, not live navigation or legal compliance certificates.

defaultPrompt: Estimate my road-freight trip cost and margin from the figures I provide.
Compare two route-cost scenarios using the same currency.
Calculate the cost of loading or delivery waiting time.
